My reply to the rude note my neighbor left me yesterday. (Keep in mind this man has harassed me, my mother, and my dogs for over a year now) he even stole my dog out of my yard off her leash, put her in his yard and called animal cruelty to remove her. This is my breaking point. My reply reads: Dear profound nuisance,Yesterday (May 21, 2014) you wrote a letter complaining about my dogs barking when I let them out in the morning. Well, I knew how much u liked my first two dogs, so we recently added another to our family. Just for u.  However, you signed the letter as, &#8220from, your neighbors&#8221. I spoke to my surrounding neighbors and none other then you heard or were bothered by my dogs barking in the morning. In fact, I didn&#8217t hear them bark yesterday morning and I live on the property :) With that said, let me inform you I am an incredibly light sleeper. For example I easily awoke you you, belligerent drunk, standing on my property yelling on May 10th around 1am, with your girlfriend, wine glass in hand. (As it always it. As we&#8217ve even seen you drinking while driving.) the ear plugs I attached are an example of how we&#8217ve dealt with you, as you are our profound nuisance, very similar to how a dog might be.  Furthermore, the dog your speaking of, is a friendly one. And trying to be the bigger neighbor, as I often am with you, I sat him down and had a stern talk with him. You know what he told me? He wouldn&#8217t bark in the mornings if you could keep your profound nuisance of a cat off our property through the night! (His words not mine.) So maybe, when you are able to control where your stray cat wanders, I will be able to control when my dog sees fit to speak. Lastly, since you have been harassing me and my family for over a year and a half now, and I have tried to be the bigger person, I am no longer trying. You have been nothing but a profound nuisance to me, and if it continues, I will become one to you. (You haven&#8217t seen nothing yet 😉) I will start by demanding you remove your fence from my property. As of today, May 22, 2014. We will begin charging you rent every day after. We checked with our lawyer. (We can actually do that) And next time you have a neighborly compliant, you can send it certified mail. Because if I catch you on my property, touching anything of mine (especially my vehicles, seeing as how after your drunk scream fest my tire was slashed..) I will call the cops, make my complaints official, and make my presence as your neighbor, truly, a profound nuisance. Sincerely.Your neighbor, to the right, in the brown house, (the one you constantly call the city on for one thing or another).
